item.title: Stability AI Closes $76M Series B Backed by Major Music Labels and EA
item.summary: Stability AI closed a $76M Series B backed by Electronic Arts, Sony Music Group, Universal Music Group, Warner Music Group, and returning investors including Coatue and Eric Schmidt, bringing total funding under CEO Prem Akkaraju to $232M as the company pivots to purpose-built generative AI tools for professional creatives.
